name: hardware intelligence
long_description: Hardware Intelligence makes chip design tools to cut development by months. When a chip test fails, engineers need a recording of every internal signal called a waveform - but it can take days to generate and can be 100s of GB. Our breakthrough is WaveZip, which captures waveforms 8x faster and 500x smaller. We're also building Wavelength, an agentic telemetry layer. Using specialized ML models and a longitudinal history of WaveZip files, we're able to surface proactive insights never possible before. With these and other tools across the chip design stack, we’ll own the observability layer every person and agent will need for chip design.
